answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 167 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the prism. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the raven queue while genuine members promoted earlier keep earning. The pearl index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A 245 account operation therefore ties up 25 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
